findings.detail: CarCard spec row (5 seats / Auto / Petrol) and the price '$—' are STATIC decoration, correctly not bound to data. AvailabilityResponse exposes only locationId/startTime/endTime/availableVehicleIds, and the template binds only vehicleId + $index. No data fields invented beyond api.models.ts.

Featured-booking dark card and 'Ready for pickup?' checklist are STATIC presentational markup (no data bindings exist for them). {{ firstName }} interpolation, errorMessage(), and all routerLink="/explore"/"/profile" preserved; quick-action tiles link only to existing routes.

Payment-summary figures ('$—') and booking timeline are STATIC. The amber status badge correctly flips to emerald via the preserved [class.confirmed]="reservation.status === 'CONFIRMED'" (SCSS .status-badge.confirmed overrides to emerald). Both DatePipe medium values, both feedback tags, and all three status @if blocks preserved.
Host Node is v25.2.1 (odd/non-LTS, outside the engines range). It emits a warning but build and tests complete successfully. Non-blocking; environmental only.

summary: DRIVE visual redesign APPROVED. (1) VISUAL-ONLY confirmed: only the two inline-template components (system-page, feedback-message) are the sole .ts files in the diff and both changed only template markup/classes and inline styles — class, selector 'app-system-page'/'app-feedback-message', and the code()/title()/message()/variant() input() APIs plus every {{ }}, @if, [class], [attr.role], routerLink binding are preserved. No app.routes.ts, guards, interceptors, core/services, core/models, auth.service, or any *.spec.ts changed. Across app-shell, the three auth screens, dashboard, explore, profile, reservation-detail, and system-page every formControlName, [formGroup], (ngSubmit)/(click), @if/@else if/@for (track + $index) control flow, signal, routerLink/routerLinkActive/[routerLinkActiveOptions], DatePipe usage, feedback-message tags, and dynamic button labels are preserved exactly. (2) No invented data fields — explore CarCard specs/price and the dashboard/reservation summary figures are static decoration faithful to the Figma look. (3) DRIVE look applied (Manrope import, blue/slate palette, panels/badges/buttons/fields/kickers, lightning-tile DRIVE wordmark); grep found zero residual wayfarer/moss/coral/clay/DM Sans/font-display tokens in src. (4) No new routes/components/dependencies (only .html/.scss/.ts-inline/index.html/styles.scss changed). (5) Verified in the worktree: 'npm run build' succeeds with no SCSS error and no anyComponentStyle 8kB budget error (styles.css 13.51 kB global; largest component chunk 17 kB JS, unrelated to style budget), and 'npm test -- --watch=false' passes 11/11 across 4 spec files.
